paper_id: Relay Decoding_ Concatenating Large Language Models for Machine Translation
title: Relay Decoding: Concatenating Large Language Models for Machine Translation
motivation: LLMs常不支持源语言和目标语言同时具备能力，continuous learning代价高昂
problem_framing: 将跨语言翻译问题重新定义为两个单语言专家模型的拼接问题
key_insight: 用简单线性映射层连接两个专家LLM，在有限平行语料上训练即可实现翻译
method_signature: 源语言LLM + 线性映射层 + 目标语言LLM的Relay Decoding架构
evaluation_criteria: BLEU和chrF指标在Multi30k和WikiMatrix数据集上的性能对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 获取平行数据的成本很高；cross-attention系列方法因参数过多在小型数据集上表现不佳
evidence_for_taste: Aquila2和LLaMA individually都不擅长中法翻译
Linear mapping method achieved the best results
cross-attention series method yield lower results
Acquiring parallel data can be costly
finetuning the parameters of the second large model yield better results
thinking_moves: 把昂贵的continuous learning问题转化为模型拼接的工程问题
通过ablation study验证哪些组件真正起作用(如Linear优于Cross-attention)
将跨语言翻译需求拆解为单语言能力组合问题
承认数据获取成本是方法局限，以此指引未来方向(探索单语数据)
